name: Dead-Letter and Quarantine
description: Tasks that repeatedly fail go to a dead-letter queue. Quarantine prevents retry storms.
purpose: Isolate permanently failing tasks and prevent them from consuming scheduler resources or causing retry storms.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks exceeding max retry count are moved to a dead-letter queue
Dead-letter queue is observable and manually reviewable
Quarantine prevents tasks from re-entering the scheduling loop
Quarantined tasks can be replayed or discarded via administrative action
Quarantine duration and retry limits are configurable
Dead-letter events trigger alerts and logging for operator attention
